data.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?

result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign, and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

My recommendation would be **Dropbox Sign for simplicity and value**, unless you need more advanced document workflows, integrations or compliance features.

The best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need clients to sign contracts, and whether you want automated reminders and templates.

## Best e-signature software compared

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for small business)

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Automatic reminders and audit trails.
- Integrates with Dropbox, Google Drive and Salesforce.
- Free plan allows 3 signature requests per month.

Pricing starts at US\$15/user/month on annual billing. [sign.dropbox.com](https://sign.dropbox.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[help.dropbox.com](https://help.dropbox.com/plans/dropbox-sign-free-plan?fallback=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best for professional contracts)

- Widely recognised by businesses.
- Excellent tracking and audit trails.
- Shared templates and team management.
- Advanced options for payments and automated workflows.

Australian pricing\:

- Personal: A\$15/month.
- Standard: A\$37/user/month.
- Business Pro: A\$59/user/month.

Standard and Business Pro include 100 envelopes per user per year. [ecom.docusign.com](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Pro - Download - CHIP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MClk9vopDK3s8yLgpEwlSEhGS0vUNzhdtqmUbe4FQUwjkrLEbfHj903AVXnzPIswOgnaFx5FfZA1g5FjMG6zgduk55Lmq4CuVWb6k1cy0o2k52PputH7ntS-DU0pcfyTIZaKTSjzV1ZHZ8mAncDr91TGqkCeOQxWfBoEa2Ixvi_E3c0VgivRjcQ5uNnxOYyq?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF documents)

- Edit PDFs and collect signatures in one place.
- Create reusable forms.
- Track signatures and document status.
- Useful if you already use Adobe Acrobat.

Acrobat Pro for teams is listed at A\$37.99/licence/month on an annual billed-monthly plan. [www.adobe.com](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/sign.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Adobe website](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/sign.html)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales proposals)

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when clients open documents.
- Collect signatures without switching platforms.

Particularly useful if you send proposals as well as contracts.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

## My recommendation

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Client agreements and formal contracts | DocuSign |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat |
| Quotes, proposals and sales | PandaDoc |
| Very occasional signing | Dropbox Sign free plan |


One important consideration in Australia: check that your chosen signing process meets the legal requirements for the particular document. Some documents have additional witnessing, identification or execution requirements; an electronic signature platform doesn't automatically satisfy all of them.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I'd like to find the best value option rather than recommend something unnecessarily expensive.

**What type of small business do you run?**

And roughly how many documents do you send for signature each month?

For example, if you're sending client agreements, service contracts, employment documents or onboarding forms, I can narrow this down to the best two options and compare their actual costs in Australian dollars.
